name: print-social-pink-sticker-cutout-books-cover
title: Pink-outlined cutout with open book, giant black caps and pink caption block
whatItIs: A white 4:5 post with a faint repeated account-name pattern. A cut-out woman with a face mask holds an open book, all outlined in thick pink. Above is a pink script number and giant black extended caps 'КНИЖКИ', with a pink rounded caption and a black arrow and handle pill.
whatItMeans: Loud, personable and feminine; the pink sticker outline turns a photo into a graphic.
techniques: Give the cutout a thick pink border like a sticker.
Overlap a pink caption box on the bottom of giant black type.
Repeat the account name as a faint ghost pattern.
Pair pink script with black heavy caps.

vocabulary.definition: A thick border around a cutout.
A faint repeated word in the background.
A number written in flourished script.
A text box that overlaps a headline.
